verses.text_uthmani: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

translations.text: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.

verses.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

translations.text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

verses.text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

translations.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

verses.text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

translations.text: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

verses.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

translations.text: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
